sessions.phase_label: Video briefing, localization, and delivery setup
Initial delivery review and revision requirements

requirements.title: UGC Video Artifact
requirements.definition: Production of the requested UGC-style video as the task deliverable.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers creation of the UGC video artifact itself; language, script fidelity, performance direction, setting, duration, and delivery behavior are independently testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Arabic MSA Localization
requirements.definition: The video's spoken content must be presented in Arabic Modern Standard Arabic, with source material translated as needed.
requirements.boundary_note: Translation is an enabling attribute of producing the Arabic MSA video, not an independently requested translation deliverable; adherence to the resulting script remains separate.

requirements.title: Spoken Script Fidelity
requirements.definition: The phrases spoken in the video must follow the supplied or approved script to the degree required by the client.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers correspondence between performed dialogue and the script; Arabic language choice and physical performance direction can change or fail independently.

requirements.title: Phone Question Reading Performance
requirements.definition: The opening performance must appear as though the actress is reading a question from her phone.
requirements.boundary_note: This opening acting behavior is independently assessable from screen-tap timing, spoken-script fidelity, and the filming environment.

requirements.title: Screen Tap Performance
requirements.definition: Screen taps shown in the video must be performed confidently and at appropriate moments.
requirements.boundary_note: Tap confidence and timing form one physical interaction mechanism; appearing to read the initial question is a separately testable acting behavior.

requirements.title: Cozy Home Interior Setting
requirements.definition: The video should be filmed in a cozy, home-like environment with a room interior visible behind the actress.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the visible filming environment; the freelancer's couch plan is an implementation choice rather than a separately authoritative Requirement.

requirements.title: Video Duration Limit
requirements.definition: The completed video must remain shorter than one minute.
requirements.boundary_note: Duration is a single measurable acceptance constraint and is independent of script fidelity or delivery method.

requirements.title: Video Delivery Channel
requirements.definition: The completed video must be delivered through the client-designated channel, such as a shared drive, accessible link, or direct chat upload.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers selection of the delivery channel; whether a link is actually accessible is a separately testable behavior.

requirements.title: Shared Video Link Accessibility
requirements.definition: When the video is delivered by link, the recipient must be able to open and view the shared file.
requirements.boundary_note: Accessibility can fail or be fixed without changing the designated delivery channel, so it remains separate from channel selection.
